title: Compile Propagation And Traversal Cascades
summary: Added a deterministic propagation compiler for causal, distance, reading, radial, branch, symmetric, and authoritative semantic-traversal cascades. It assigns semantic ranks before timing, applies only bounded stable-ID variation, preserves dot-product index order, and refuses promotion when cohesion, readiness, legibility, overlap, or normalized act-window constraints cannot all hold.
